'''High-g suits''',<ref name="SWS" /> also known as '''high-gravity stress flight suits'''<ref name="SWTSE">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref> were a specialized garment worn by [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] pilots while in flight. The suit dampened the effects of high-speed maneuvering.

They retailed for two hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], and were readily available throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in large [[City/Legends|cities]] and [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]].<ref name="SWS" />
